scope: fixed prior DTU scenes/configuration; audit and diagnostic ablations only, no new method selection or tuning

new_ablations.filter_keep_unknown: frozen filter keep OR finite with zero valid other-view depth observation; only unknown handling changes
new_ablations.fusion_without_raw_support: same frozen correspondences, alpha and classical weights, replace raw weight 1+s/(N-1) by 1
new_ablations.joint_fixed_poses: same frozen problem/initial points/weights/priors/loss/bounds/budget, all poses fixed to source fusion; optimize only point coordinates

selection_gate_control: natural all8 gate vs no-geometric-evidence gate; additionally dev-only all_unknown counterfactual, preserving identity/hash/status/artifact gates; diagnostics never presented as actual evidence
evaluation: same 200000 fixed prediction IDs and STL cap, same raw-camera GT Sim3, dynamic and fixed-raw ROI sensitivity, 1/2/5mm P/R/F1, accuracy/completeness, previous failure-aware pose AUC; no sampling expansion

runtime.device: CPU vectorization and sparse SciPy TRF/LSMR
runtime.solver_budget: inherit frozen joint config, max_nfev60 / wall20s; no new models, weights or dependencies

acceptance.engineering: all immutable inputs/rules/source hashes verified, baseline results reproduced, required controls and failure catalog complete, GT guards and regression checks pass
acceptance.scientific: stable improvement over raw is a separate claim, not implied by engineering completion; no significance/generalization claims from two dependent scene groups
